description: Abstract class for unary expressions in Twig's node expression hierarchy, providing common compile logic and enforcing implementation of the 'operator' method for subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractUnary
classes.description: Abstract base class for unary expression nodes in Twig's compilation tree. Defines common compile behavior and enforces subclasses to specify the unary operator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a node (expression) and line number; triggers deprecation warning if node is not an instance of AbstractExpression. Calls parent constructor with node and parsing options.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the unary expression into PHP code, adding parentheses if explicitly specified, invoking the 'operator' method, and compiling the inner node.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to output the specific unary operator during compilation.
